subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-party Memory Core operator facade for remember/recall/review/edit/forget, or leave that lifecycle to external memory plugins until the canonical Memory MVP contracts land?
rationale: The requested surface defines durable memory lifecycle, provenance, ingestion, and active memory plugin-slot semantics rather than wiring existing commands together, and VISION.md keeps memory both plugin-owned and on a path toward one recommended default.

options.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

options.title: Prototype Externally First
options.body: Use Memory LanceDB, Engram-style tooling, or another ClawHub package to validate the workflow until OpenClaw exposes any missing generic seams.

options.title: Reject First-Party Facade
options.body: Close the first-party operator facade if maintainers decide write, review, and forget commands should not be a default OpenClaw product surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest recent source-history signal on Memory Core CLI/docs and VISION memory guidance that frame this product boundary.
